inputs.text:
The Floor-length curtains should hang from a stainless steel curtain rod mounted above the window. Ensure:

Triple pinch pleats at the top with deep, crisp, uniform folds all the way down.

Fabric must appear slightly thick, not sheer, with natural drape and realistic depth.

There should be a small opening in the middle, revealing part of the window.

The curtain rod must stay fully visible above the pleats and must not intersect or disappear into the fabric.

The fabric texture should accurately wrap and deform across the pleats and folds, maintaining sharpness and realism.

Lighting, shadows, and reflections must match the lighting of the room image.

Final output should look high-resolution, photorealistic, seamlessly integrated into the real scene.
